issue.title: Mac testPomodoroNamePromptUsesConfiguredThemesInConfigOrder expects old themes copy after types rename
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `BobMacCaptureTests.CapturePanelModelTests/testPomodoroNamePromptUsesConfiguredThemesInConfigOrder`

Fails on macOS CI run 41102288270 (snapshot ed6e160ac3dfe9460c5e85cd2d75f0e17c31ce19): XCTAssertEqual failed - got "SNACK isn't one of your types; tasks here keep their own types" but expected "SNACK isn't one of your configured themes". The copy changed under task-types epic commits 7ac2bd9/2f9a70a; the test expectation was not updated. e6 and ee are closed, so no active epic owns it. Not a flake: deterministic string mismatch, fails on CI while unrelated to wikilink changes.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic copy mismatch from task-types rename (7ac2bd9/2f9a70a); fails on macOS CI run 41102288270, not intermittent and not caused by wikilink changes.

issue.creation_reason: Mac CI fails because task-types changed the unconfigured-name copy; the test still expects the old themes wording. Not e7-caused and not intermittent.
